scope: FRESH AS ORIGINALLY RUN. Frozen adaptive settings on all twelve native 512x512 SIPI color aerials. Subsequent tuning on these inputs is not fresh validation.

protocol.scope: Frozen before measuring any aerial image. This file records a protocol, not results.
protocol.corpus: USC SIPI aerials, all twelve native 512x512 color images 2.1.01 through 2.1.12
protocol.selection: Publisher-listed native dimensions and color type only; no crops, resizing, previews, or result-based exclusions. The 1024x1024 and 2250x2250 images are outside this validation's compute budget.
protocol.prior_known_inputs: Kodak 01-03 development; all 14 SIPI miscellaneous color images now regressions

learned.precision_scope: Power-of-two-grid rounding of hidden/head weight matrices only, unchanged guide, affine, and biases. Binary16 model tensors remain in-band.
learned.format: self-contained integer NNEX v2 with SHA-256 raw RGB checksum

protocol.selection_rule: Encode all eight learned candidates, verify each independently, choose the smallest complete file against the actual wrapped SCDX. Keep floor on ties.
protocol.baselines: Exact RGB PNG (Pillow optimize), WebP lossless cwebp -z 9 -exact, native JPEG XL lossless effort 9, numthreads 1; verify every round-trip
protocol.reporting: All twelve images, complete files including transmitted model and headers, per-image and aggregate bytes, exact RGBA verification, hashes. No adaptive tuning during this cohort. Runtime under concurrent workers is not isolated latency.
protocol.limitations: One small aerial corpus, not broad proof or maximum-strength coverage of all existing codecs. Production defaults remain unchanged.

source_manifest.selection: Every native 512x512 color image in the published aerials volume, selected before compression measurements. Larger native images are outside this validation's compute budget. No previews, crops, resizing, or result-based selection.
source_manifest.transform: TIFF to PNG, exact RGB samples verified, no resizing
source_manifest.role: fresh held-out validation; not used to select model parameters

cross_isa.warning: Two executable builds on one host, not independent physical machines.

independent_decode_observations.scope: Sequential post-training single observations on this Mac, not statistically stable latency measurements. NNEX includes subprocess/config/temp-file overhead; JXL uses its native in-process decoder. Both return RGBA; baseline encoding excluded.

source_hash_scope: Implementation files at receipt finalization, not a commit. Only CLI length guards, test/docs, cross-ISA tooling, and legacy-runner import safety changed during validation; no training, quantization, inference or selection rules changed.
limitations: One native 512x512 aerial corpus, not broad all-image or large-resolution proof.
Baseline comparison covers measured PNG/WebP lossless and JXL effort9, not every codec or maximum JXL effort.
Training used three concurrent workers sharing MPS; per-image seconds are not isolated latency.
ARM64 and x86_64 under Rosetta on the same Mac, not two physical machines.
Experimental format, no production integration or comprehensive hostile-input audit.
Every selected model is transmitted and counted. Pixel samples are exact, not original file bytes or source metadata.
